answers.core:
- This is a very core feature for editor usability.
- Would be very useful for debugging if implemented properly like suggested above.
- Specially useful if you're dealing with physics interpolation, or any 1-frame glitches.
- All sorts of projects can benefit from being able to see things happening frame-by-frame and/or tick-by-tick.
- Unity has it out-of-the-box. This would help adaptation when coming from Unity.
- I assume it would be somewhat simple to implement?
answers.workaround:
An editor plugin *might* be able to implement this?
But I have no idea if it would be easy/feasible to make it integrate properly with the other debugging tools.
